title: Oleksandr Vysotskyi
summary: Oleksandr Oleksandrovych Vysotskyi is a former professional football goalkeeper from [[ukraine|Ukraine]], born on 16 June 1986. His career in football reflects the sporting culture and talent development within Ukraine.

sections.heading: Early Life and Background
paragraphs: Oleksandr Vysotskyi was born on 16 June 1986 [[coal-in-ukraine|in Ukraine]], where he began his journey in the world of football.

sections.heading: Professional Career
paragraphs: Vysotskyi played as a goalkeeper in professional football, contributing to the sport's landscape in Ukraine.
